text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while training in preparation
for the Unicorn Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaargh...!
Every single day, it's the exact same training over and over...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This is so booooring, nanoda...
I'm going home for today, nanoda.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!
I can't be doing boring stuff all the time!
Bleh bleh bleeeh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She was never particularly diligent to begin with.
She's probably only made it this far on the thrill of her debut."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have to find a way to get her motivation back!
But how...?
Just as that thought crossed my mind—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, excuse me.
Do you have a moment right now?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's wonderful news.
Shinko Windy received
an incredible offer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Apparently, there's going to be an exhibition race
organized for a TV program...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "That exhibition race is a special feature for a wildly popular variety show, and it's supposedly being broadcast live nationwide on TV and the internet."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Apparently, veteran comedians are holding a special race where they nominate their favorite Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thankfully, it seems someone who watched Shinko Windy's debut race took an interest in her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it won't go down in official records as an 'exhibition match'...
This is a grand stage watched by an immense number of people!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And so, the other party specifically nominated
Shinko Windy as their favorite Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The perfect stage to stand out as much as I want...!
With a goal like this, I can really put my all into training!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Minion~! I came to play with y... Huh, Tazuna-san? What's going on?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After explaining the situation
and the event race to her...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "Broadcast live nationwide", you say?!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm going, I'm going, I'm goingggg!!
I am definitely goooiiinnnggg~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The whole country's gonna see Windy-chan?!
I gotta do it, no matter whaaat!
choice_data_list: We've got to train if we want to win.
We've got to train if we want to win, you know?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I will, I will! Of course I will, noda!
Windy-chan is gonna get super serious, noda!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! If Windy-chan kicks her rivals to the curb, her awesome power will echo across the whole racing world, no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!! Now that that's settled,
let's add it to the menu right away!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan is already super strong, but I'll train even more, win by a massive lead, and stand out more than anyone elseee!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, do your best, okay?♪
The Academy will give you its full backing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ever since then—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Fuhaa~~~! Not yet, keep going!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I swam 100 meters, 100 times!
I can keep going for more~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmh! I told you I can still keep going!
Are you gonna say "Resting is part of training" again?
choice_data_list: Umm, ah! There's a water gun in the storage room!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Humph! Now is no time for playing pranks!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, you really are something...
You have no concentration despite being an adult.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan will be poolside, hydrating and reading through the textbook, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Uryaryaryaryaryaaaaahhhh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Windy-senpai...
What incredible intensity...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Say what you will,
you're still training properly, aren't you?
Heheh...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm doing another lap too!
Next time, I'm taking that GⅠ—!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah...!
Pheeewww!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Midnight... feels like a time for bad guys, nanoda.
All pitch-black and quiet...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: My mental training is coming along nicely, too...âª

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy takes 1st—!
Strong! Too strong!
True demonic majesty! A splendid and crushing victory~~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah-hah!
Hah-hah-hah-hah-haah! Did ya see that~?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Gyafun!
To think I'd be beaten by a historic,
massive lead like this~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
What incredible speed!
I'm gonna be talking about today for the next hundred years...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, I terrify myself with my own strength...!
Wahahahaha—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Fufun... fufufun...♪

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text:
Who's that training over there?!
Do you know what time it is?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh shoot! It's a security guard!
Run for it~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Day in and day out, Shinko Windy trained with all her might.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what was my time?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehehehe...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Wah-hah-hah-hah-hah-haaa!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan really is super-duper strong!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan is definitely gonna win this!
The Windy-chan era is finally arriving~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has shown phenomenal growth in such a short period of time.
I knew my eyes hadn't deceived me.
When she channels her concentration, she is formidable...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer... We're gonna win.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
On this grand stage where everrryone is watching,
Windy-chan is gonna seize a historic, massive victory!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy is strong.
I had no doubt in my mind that she would win and seize glory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At the time, I had no idea...
